restoration_note: Teaching describes the upward gathering-inward ladder: each cosmic element conjoins to its inner kindred (X of X), the elements collectively to the Tamr, then Tamr→Answer→Call→Mind/Noeric→Pillar of Glory→First Man→Ambassador→Aeons of the Greatness. The repeated 'X of X' formula and the visible chain links constrain almost every fill. Most are single-letter or short editorial restorations confirmed by the parallel structure. {4} requires the longest fill (closing the previous water-of-water clause and supplying the new subject) and {5} is the only genuinely ambiguous case; the plural English 'are gathered' suggests ⲡⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ 'they all,' marking the transition from elements-as-many to the named stations above.

restorations.basis: Single-letter completion of ⲛ̄ⲥⲧⲟⲓⲭⲉⲓⲟⲛ 'of the elements'; editor's fill confirmed by the title 'Concerning the Gathering-Inward.'
Single-letter restoration of plural article ⲛ̄- before ⲥⲧⲟⲓⲭⲉⲓⲟⲛ 'the elements.'
Line 4332 ends ⲡⲟⲩ-, completing as ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ 'the light' (Lycopolitan form, lexicon ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ). The light is the first subject of the elemental chain.
Single-letter directional preposition ⲁ- before ⲧⲥⲉⲧⲉ 'fire,' parallel to ⲁⲡⲧⲏⲩ in line 4334 and ⲁⲡⲧⲁⲙⲣ in line 4335.

restorations.basis: Line 4333 ends ⲥⲱⲩⲍ ⲁ- (gathers in-); the iterative formula 'X of X; X itself gathers in-' (parallel to ⲧⲥⲉⲧⲉ ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ ⲧⲥⲉⲧⲉ ⲍⲱⲱⲥ) requires closing the water clause and introducing the next subject before ⲥⲱⲩⲍ ⲁⲍⲟⲩⲛ ⲁⲡⲧⲏⲩ. Lexicon ⲡⲙⲁⲩ for 'water.'

The English plural 'are gathered' and the transition from the elemental cycle to the named stations point to ⲡⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ 'all of them' (the elements as a whole gather to the Tamr). Trace ⲩ at gap-end fits ⲡⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ; reading explicitly says 'the elements gather to the Tamr.' Editor's ⲧⲏ (=ⲧⲏⲩ 'wind') is grammatically possible but does not explain the plural verb.
Genitive linker ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ closing 'Answer of the Answer' (parallel to ⲧⲥⲉⲧⲉ ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ ⲧⲥⲉⲧⲉ, ⲡⲧⲁⲙⲣ ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ ⲡⲧⲁⲙⲣ).
Directional preposition + masculine article before ⲛⲟⲩⲥ ⲉⲧⲥⲁⲧϥ̄ 'the chosen Mind'; parallel to ⲁⲡⲧⲁⲙⲣ, ⲁⲡⲟⲩⲱϣⲃⲉ, ⲁⲡⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ.
Lexicon ⲡⲥⲧⲩⲗⲟⲥ ⲙ̄ⲡⲉⲁⲩ 'the Pillar of Glory' — fixed Manichaean technical term.
Repeated ⲡⲥⲧⲩⲗⲟⲥ ⲙ̄ⲡⲉⲁⲩ in the chain-formula (the Pillar gathers to the First Man).
Lexicon ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ 'the First Man'; line 4338 ends ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ ⲛ̄ and the gap completes ⲣⲱⲙⲉ across the line break.
Directional ⲁ- + ⲛⲁⲓⲱⲛ giving ⲁⲛⲁⲓⲱⲛ 'to the aeons,' completing the construction ⲁⲛⲁⲓⲱⲛ ⲛ̄ⲧⲙ̄ⲛ̄ⲧⲛⲁⲟ̄ 'to the Aeons of the Greatness' (lexicon: ⲁⲓⲱⲛ; ⲧⲙⲛ̄ⲧⲛⲁⲟ̄ = the Greatness).
Future III converter ⲉⲩⲛⲁ- 'they shall gather' — required by 'they shall go up to the upper place' which follows; matches the simultaneous-conjunction climax of the reading.
ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲧⲡⲉ 'the upper place' — standard cosmological term for the heavenly destination, confirmed by ⲁⲡⲙⲁⲛⲙ̄ⲧⲁⲛ 'to the place of rest' that follows.
